name: prompt-stacker
description: Chrome extension that queues prompts for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and DeepSeek, sends the next one when the current reply finishes, and saves ChatGPT images as a ZIP.

scripts.test: node test/parse.test.cjs && node test/position.test.cjs && node test/merge.test.cjs && node --test test/image-safety.test.cjs test/thread-assets.test.cjs && node test/verify-current-thread.cjs
